user.title: Set up Proxy Bridge
user.description: An existing bootstrap installation was found. Import its settings, or configure a new proxy route from scratch.

menu_options.bootstrap_import: Import settings from the bootstrap copy

connection.title: Upstream proxy
connection.description: Enter the proxy that can reach the internet. Username and password are optional; leave them empty for open proxies. When editing an existing route, leave the password empty to keep the saved one. The **Verify certificate** option only applies to `https://` proxies.

data.insecure: Skip TLS certificate verification (https proxies only)

data_description.proxy_type: http and https use a CONNECT tunnel; socks5h lets the proxy resolve host names; socks5 resolves them locally.
data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the proxy, without a scheme or port.
data_description.username: Only for proxies that require authentication.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the saved password when editing an existing route.

routes.title: Routed hosts
routes.description: Pick the host names whose traffic should go through the proxy, or type extra patterns such as `*.example.com`. The defaults cover GitHub and HACS.

data_description.name: Shown in the integration list; also used as the unique id.
data_description.hosts: Exact host names or wildcard patterns. `*.example.com` matches sub-domains only.
data_description.retries: How many times a failed GET/HEAD request is retried through the proxy (0-10).
data_description.test_connection: Uncheck to save even when the proxy cannot be reached right now.

error.invalid_host: The host must not contain a scheme, a path or spaces.
error.invalid_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the routed hosts through this proxy. Details: {error}

abort.already_configured: A proxy route with this name already exists.
abort.import_failed: The YAML configuration could not be imported. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This route is already configured under a different name.

bootstrap_detected.title: Proxy Bridge: bootstrap copy still installed
bootstrap_detected.description:
The bootstrap copy of Proxy Bridge is installed ({count} entry/entries). The managed copy is now handling the routing, so the bootstrap integration is redundant.

Remove `custom_components/proxy_bridge_bootstrap` from your configuration directory, delete its entry under Settings > Devices & services, then restart Home Assistant. Keeping both installed is harmless but routes traffic twice.

hosts.description: Host names to test; the first reachable one is used.
